title: Himachal BJP to hold protest over pending women’s aid

ai.summary: Himachal Pradesh BJP plans a statewide protest from December 1-25 demanding ₹72,000 for women instead of ₹1,500 monthly aid promised by the Congress government.

facts.claim: Himachal Pradesh BJP chief Rajeev Bindal said the party will launch a statewide Seva Doot Abhiyan from December 1 to December 25, covering all 68 assembly constituencies of the state.
facts.quote: Himachal Pradesh BJP chief Rajeev Bindal said the party will launch a statewide Seva Doot Abhiyan from December 1 to December 25, covering all 68 assembly constituencies of the state.

facts.claim: Himachal Pradesh BJP chief Rajeev Bindal on Tuesday said a women-led protest will be held against the state government on November 19 in Dharamshala over the failure to fulfil its promise of ₹1,500 monthly assistance to women.
facts.quote: Himachal Pradesh BJP chief Rajeev Bindal on Tuesday said a women-led protest will be held against the state government on November 19 in Dharamshala over the failure to fulfil its promise of ₹1,500 monthly assistance to women.

facts.claim: The BJP will seek release of ₹72,000, not just ₹1,500 and demand that the benefit be extended to all 28 lakh women in the state.
facts.quote: The BJP will seek release of ₹72,000, not just ₹1,500 and demand that the benefit be extended to all 28 lakh women in the state.

ai.background_note: The BJP is demanding higher women's aid funds than the promised ₹1,500 monthly assistance, targeting all 28 lakh women in Himachal Pradesh.
